newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU hopes Hebron deal will boost confidence.
newsitem.headline: EU hopes Hebron deal will boost confidence.

text.p: The European Union congratulated Israel and the PLO on Wednesday for their agreement extending Palestinian rule to the West Bank town of Hebron.
"This agreement marks an important step on the road towards a just and stable peace in the Middle East," said Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo, who currently holds the EU presidency.
"It can provide the new momentum that is necessary to reinvigorate the peace process."

Israel's cabinet and the Palestinian Authority will meet separately later on Wednesday to approve a deal initialled by negotiators at a late-night summit between Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestine President Yasser Arafat.
Van Mierlo said the EU would continue to try and help in bolstering the Middle East peace process and its special envoy, Miguel Angel Moratinos, would maintain close contact with all parties.

"The EU expresses the hope that the Hebron agreement will strengthen the mutual confidence which is indispensible for the further implementation of the Oslo-agreements and the speedy and successful resumption of the permanent status negotiations," Van Mierlo said.
